hooks.name: qrspi-intent-reminder
hooks.description: Guide Codex toward the QRSPI skills and qrspi CLI for workflow-related requests.
instructions: Use the qrspi-cli-workflow skill for QRSPI workflow operations.
Use the qrspi-gate-review skill when the user asks to review or decide a gate artifact.
Use `qrspi status --json` to understand the current workflow state before acting.
Do not manually modify .qrspi state files.
Gate reviews must be recorded through `qrspi approve --json` or `qrspi reject --json`.
Do not bypass D, S, or PR human gates.
